title: Hybrid ephemeral server lifecycle state
description: Local and off-host runtime state for one disposable Cinderwell host. Records provider resource IDs and private aliases, never secret values. A single primary record is tracked: there is no restore target, because source-only hosts have nothing to restore.

generation.description: Monotonically increasing. A load that observes a lower generation than the last one written is treated as rollback and refused.

config_digest.description: Canonical digest of the configuration this state was produced under. A mismatch invalidates every recorded plan hash.

authority.description: The record of *how* a mutation was authorized, written into state and into receipts. This definition is the single source of truth for that shape: state.schema.json and receipt.schema.json carry copies, and a test asserts all three are byte-identical, because a contract stated twice is a contract that drifts.

kind.description: `approval` means an artifact named this plan. `terminal` means a controlling terminal was present and the operator confirmed at the prompt. Neither is silently substituted for the other; the receipt says which.

phase.description: Fail-closed lifecycle phases. FAILED is terminal for automation and requires operator review; it never implies resources are absent.

run_id.description: Purpose-specific identifier for one lifecycle attempt. Binds evidence, labels, and the console fingerprint check.

plan_hash.description: Hash of the immutable plan this record was created under. Applying a plan whose hash does not match refuses before mutation.

authority.description: How the mutation that produced this record was authorized. Written before the provider is called, so a crash mid-create still leaves the answer to 'who asked for this machine' on disk.

expires_at.description: RFC3339 instant this host stops being allowed to exist, copied verbatim from the approved plan rather than recomputed. Recorded before the provider is called, so a machine that exists always has a readable expiry -- including one whose creation then failed.

image_id.description: Immutable numeric image ID. Mutable names such as 'latest' are rejected at config load, not here.
